batched_tokens_scan.finding: U-shaped curve; 8192 is optimal for both c32 and c64. No c64 TTFT improvement.

max_seqs_scan.finding: 64 eliminates request queuing for c64 (25x TTFT reduction from baseline). 128 adds negligible gain.

key_findings: c32 performance is stable and fast (TTFT ~1s, TP ~530)
max-num-seqs=64 is the critical knob: eliminates queuing for high concurrency
batched-tokens=8192 cannot be increased further without OOM risk
prefill bottleneck: batched=8192 allows only 2 requests per prefill batch at 4K input
c48/c64 TTFT (~13s) is dominated by prefill scheduling delay, not decode queuing
TPOT is robust (58-66ms) across all concurrencies
GPU memory: ~3.4 GB HBM per NPU used (out of 64 GB, <6% utilization)

recommendations.low_concurrency: batched=8192, seqs=64 — excellent TTFT (~1s) for c≤32
recommendations.high_concurrency: batched=8192, seqs=64 — TTFT ~14s for c=64; further improvement requires batched-tokens increase or prefill parallelism
future_work: Increase batched-tokens beyond 8192 (if VRAM allows) to increase prefill batch size
Explore prefill-specific parallelism (tensor parallelism + sequence parallelism)
Consider decoding-aware scheduling to prioritize prefill of waiting requests
